flavor: "Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."\n—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Arc Lightning
text: Arc Lightning deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
flavor: "It is vain to look for a defense against lightning."\n—Publius Syrus, Maxim 835, trans. Lyman
rulings: [{'date': '2014-09-20', 'text': 'If some of the creatures are illegal targets as Arc Lightning tries to resolve, the original division of damage still applies but no damage is dealt to the illegal targets. name: Dauthi Slayer
text: Shadow (This creature can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.)\nDauthi Slayer attacks each combat if able.
flavor: "A wisp of life remains in the undergloom of Death: a visible form, though no heart beats within it."\n—Homer, *The Iliad*, trans. Fitzgerald
rulings: [{'date': '2021-03-19', 'text': 'If an attacking creature has multiple evasion abilities, such as shadow and flying, a creature can block it only if that creature satisfies all of the appropriate evasion abilities.'}, {'date': '2021-03-19', 'text': 'Multiple instances of shadow on the same creature are redundant.'}, {'date': '2021-03-19', 'text': 'Once a creature has been blocked, that creature remains blocked and will deal and be dealt combat damage even if it gains or loses shadow or if the blocking creature gains or loses shadow.'}]
